rows.text: 你穿了四年的靴子，底快磨穿了，鞋面還好，現在會想留下哪一半？
rows.locator: first paragraph, explicitly attributed in next line
rows.action: examining a worn lace-up work boot with a thin outsole

rows.text: 二〇二五年七月，一位馬汀靴送修者在公開評論裡，寫下這個難題。
rows.locator: publishedDate 2025-07-11; four years, upper fine, sole almost worn through
rows.action: writing on a blank page beside a worn plain boot

rows.text: 選修理時，對方還能挑鞋底和縫線的顏色，覺得很有趣。
rows.locator: Public July review: choose colour of sole/weld/stitching, which was fun; choice appears before parcel packing in original account. No exact selected palette or invented click action.
rows.action: comparing a replacement sole and plain thread spools beside a worn boot
rows.prompt: Overhead view at a simple packing table, one anonymous adult comparing a replacement sole and plain thread spools beside a worn boot, even workshop light.

rows.text: 我想跟著它看：修理要拆到哪裡，包裹回來時，又多了什麼？
rows.locator: teardown scope; laces surprise withheld
rows.action: studying an idle shoe-joining machine beside a closed parcel

rows.text: 我們就看這一雙馬汀靴，能不能把主人穿慣的鞋面留下來。
rows.locator: One-pair promise and retained-upper question, not a list of future chapters or three components; current repair scope and attributed public case.
rows.action: holding a plain unfinished boot above a repair bench

rows.text: 為了留下你穿慣的鞋面，換掉的到底會有哪些東西？
rows.locator: central question
rows.action: tracing the seam around a worn work boot

chapters.title: 選好的靴子裝進了鞋盒

rows.text: 選項裡有一條沿條，可是它在鞋上的哪裡？
rows.locator: identification
rows.action: looking closely at the stitched edge of a work boot

rows.text: 你順著鞋面往下看，鞋邊有一條繞著鞋身的帶子，上面可以看見縫線。
rows.locator: identification paragraph; 2–4s
rows.action: pointing to a narrow band below a boot upper

rows.text: 維修方說，有沿條的鞋，會在這個部位露出細小的縫隙。
rows.locator: small visible gap
rows.action: touching the small gap along a stitched boot rim

rows.text: 從正上方看，鞋底邊緣還伸出比較寬的一圈，不跟鞋面完全齊平。
rows.locator: wide profile from birds eye view
rows.action: examining the wide outline of a boot sole from above

rows.text: 鞋邊那圈線，只是讓人一眼認出它的裝飾嗎？
rows.locator: Welt is stitched to upper and integral to structure; question answered by existing 20208–09.
rows.action: comparing a stitched shoe edge with a separate plain band

rows.text: 我原先會把那圈線看成裝飾；近看才注意，它縫著一個真正的部件。
rows.locator: welt stitched to upper
rows.action: lifting the edge of a worn boot to inspect its stitching

rows.text: 那條帶子叫做沿條，縫在鞋面下緣；網站把換底和換沿條列成同一項修理。
rows.locator: service name and construction
rows.action: placing a flexible band beside the lower edge of a boot upper

rows.text: 要把這一雙交出去修，現在頁面標出的費用是多少？
rows.locator: current listed £79.99 per pair; not reviewer's historical payment
rows.action: holding a worn pair beside a blank service card at a counter

rows.text: 目前網站的經典換底加換沿條，標價是一雙七十九英鎊九十九便士。
rows.locator: current listed per-pair price £79.99 at retrieval; no claim this was the reviewer's 2025 payment
rows.action: examining a blank service card beside a pair of worn boots

rows.text: 那位評論者則覺得，自己的這次修理，比另買一雙二手鞋還便宜。
rows.locator: Public review personal price judgment only; not current listing, representative market comparison, or a replay of deciding to send the parcel.
rows.action: considering a worn boot beside a plain secondhand shoe

rows.text: 鞋面還好，把靴口翻開，後跟內裡若已磨穿，要把外皮也換掉嗎？
rows.locator: conditional viewer inspection; heel lining described separately from upper
rows.action: opening the boot shaft to inspect the inner heel

rows.text: 若後跟內裡已磨穿，維修方可以修補，或換上新的皮內裡。
rows.locator: HEEL LINING REPAIR only: repair or replace worn/damaged heel lining with new leather; not all lining.
rows.action: holding a new plain heel-lining patch beside a boot opening

rows.text: 照他們的說法，處理後跟內裡能恢復舒適，也減少上層鞋面進一步受磨。
rows.locator: restores comfort and prevents further wear to upper, attributed
rows.action: touching the inside heel of a plain lace-up boot

rows.text: 你要留下的外皮，和腳在裡面碰到的內裡，在這裡成了能分開處理的部位。
rows.locator: explanation of inner lining repair as distinct component; not condition of either filmed or reviewed pair
rows.action: placing a plain lining sample beside a worn outer upper

rows.text: 星期四，對方把鞋放進舊鞋盒，印好郵寄標籤；隔天，郵差收走了盒子。
rows.locator: Thursday packed old shoebox and printed prepaid label; next-day collection
rows.action: placing worn lace-up boots into a used unmarked shoebox

rows.text: 鞋送出去，穿著者會先等到什麼消息？
rows.locator: first receipt update
rows.action: looking at a blank notification screen beside an empty shoebox

rows.text: 這位送修者說，維修方收到靴子後，先發來通知，鞋已經到站了。
rows.locator: update once received boots
rows.action: reading a blank message screen after posting a parcel

rows.text: 通知讓主人知道包裹到了；工作檯上，接著輪到人把舊接合拆開。
rows.locator: editorial transition from reported receipt to separate authorised demonstration
rows.action: holding a closed shoe parcel at a repair counter

rows.text: 師傅手上的刀，會讓這雙靴子先少掉什麼？
rows.locator: teardown scope; separate demonstration 5–7s
rows.action: positioning a worn boot upside down on a repair stand

chapters.title: 舊底拆走，新線繞上鞋面

rows.text: 授權換底頁說，要先移走舊外底、沿條和縫線；示範裡，師傅倒放靴子，刀沿鞋底上緣走。
rows.locator: Authorised service lists removal of old sole, welt and stitching; separate demonstration 5–6s shows inverted boot and knife moving along upper outsole edge. Component list is from the page, not a claim that each component is separately identifiable in the film; not the public reviewer’s physical pair.
rows.action: guiding a plain knife along the upper edge of an old outsole

rows.text: 你還看得到鞋邊舊線，刀口沿著它附近前進，舊接合開始分開。
rows.action: holding a worn boot steady while opening its old edge seam

rows.text: 接著，靴底已經露出內層，外面原本貼地的整塊底不在了。
rows.action: examining the exposed underside of an intact boot upper

rows.text: 我會盯著露出的接合位置：師傅接著會把這裡送向哪個工具？
rows.action: lifting a boot upper with its lower joining edge exposed

rows.text: 鏡頭接著對準倒過來的靴底，一個噴口靠近露出的底層，師傅用布包住握鞋的手。
rows.locator: 6–7.5s; nozzle near exposed base and cloth at supporting hand; no inferred temperature
rows.action: holding an inverted boot near a guarded nozzle with a cloth-wrapped hand

rows.text: 鞋底朝上、靴筒朝下，他把上半部整個握在手裡，沒有把皮面拆成一片片。
rows.locator: 6–8s; intact three-dimensional upper after outsole removal
rows.action: gripping an intact boot upper with its base facing upwards

rows.text: 下方要重新接合，上方仍維持著鞋的形狀；接著，這個留下來的部分才被送向機針。
rows.locator: 7.5–8s transition, retained upper oriented toward sewing machine
rows.action: moving a retained boot upper toward an idle stitching machine

rows.text: 可是舊底都拿走了，新底要直接縫到這層皮上嗎？
rows.locator: welt first stitched to upper
rows.action: holding a separate sole near the exposed lower edge of an upper

rows.text: 原廠現行工法先處理沿條：把一條聚氯乙烯材料做的帶子，縫上鞋面。
rows.locator: PVC welt first stitched to upper
rows.action: guiding a flexible band along a boot upper at a sewing station

rows.text: 示範裡，師傅讓靴子沿著機針轉動，新的縫線一段接一段，繞回鞋邊。
rows.action: turning a boot slowly at a plain heavy sewing machine

rows.text: 機器往前車，他的手也跟著調整位置，帶著這隻立體的靴子走過機針。
rows.action: supporting the boot body while guiding its curved edge beneath a needle

rows.text: 沿條車好，師傅再把靴底朝向修整工具，轉著鞋身處理邊緣。
rows.locator: 13.15–14.7s; contact at tool beneath right machine head, belt contact not established; independent r2 13.6s frame readback.
rows.action: turning an unfinished boot edge toward a guarded edge-finishing tool

rows.text: 淺色的底層朝外，黑色鞋邊靠近機器；新外底還沒接上，就先處理這一圈。
rows.locator: 13.15–14.7s; contact at tool beneath right machine head, belt contact not established; independent r2 13.6s frame readback.
rows.action: holding an inverted upper with its pale base facing a guarded edge-finishing station

rows.text: 它會怎麼接上去，讓這隻還露著底層的靴子重新能走路？
rows.locator: joining procedure
rows.action: positioning a loose sole beneath the open base of a boot

rows.text: 輪到熱接了。師傅拿起新外底，放到已縫好沿條的鞋面下方。
rows.locator: joining paragraph; 15–18s
rows.action: placing a fresh plain outsole under a stitched upper

rows.text: 公司說，今天多數外底用的是聚氯乙烯合金，也就是常叫PVC的塑膠。
rows.locator: majority of outsoles alloy of PVC
rows.action: examining plain plastic granules beside a moulded sole

rows.text: 一粒粒顆粒先熔融，再成型為鞋底，才有前掌、後跟和腳下的輪廓。
rows.locator: granules melted and moulded; 15–17s
rows.action: lifting a formed sole beside an unmarked mould and granules

rows.text: 你熟悉的氣墊，原廠在Original系列裡，用鞋底的氣穴來解釋舒適和吸震。
rows.locator: Original products air pockets comfort and shock absorption
rows.action: holding a simple section model with visible small sole cavities

rows.text: 他調整鞋底與鞋身的位置，讓這個新部件準備接到剛剛縫好的那圈邊。
rows.locator: 15–18s; joining paragraph
rows.action: aligning a replacement sole with a stitched footwear band

rows.text: 我原先以為車線縫好就行，這裡卻改用熱刀；這道接底工序要多熱？
rows.locator: two sequential joining methods
rows.action: examining an idle blade tool beside a shoe-joining station

rows.text: 原廠給這道接底工序的數字，是熱接溫度超過六百五十度。
rows.locator: welded at temperature in excess of 650C; manufacturing operation only
rows.action: positioning an unfinished boot at a guarded heated joining tool

rows.text: 熱刀加熱接合處，滾輪再把沿條和外底壓在一起。
rows.locator: hot blade and pressurised rollers force parts together
rows.action: pressing two plain footwear components together at a joining station

rows.text: 工具接觸鞋邊時，靴子的其他邊緣，要怎麼跟著送過去？
rows.locator: 18–20s: hands rotate the upper as edge is fed to tool; next visible action answers how.
rows.action: turning a boot by hand beside a guarded assembly machine

rows.text: 鏡頭裡，接合工具靠近鞋邊時，邊緣透出橙紅的亮光，雙手仍扶在鞋身兩側。
rows.locator: 18–20s; visible glow and hand position, not a temperature reading
rows.action: supporting a boot beside a narrow warm joining edge

rows.text: 修鞋的人把靴子往另一個方向轉，剛才朝著自己的那段鞋邊，又移到機器前。
rows.locator: 18–20s; hand-fed rotation visible across sampled frames
rows.action: rotating a partly joined boot toward the next side of the tool

rows.text: 你從側面看，新底上緣貼近沿條，剛才分開的兩個部件，沿著邊緣合攏。
rows.locator: welding; 18–20s
rows.action: examining the meeting edges of a fresh sole and a stitched band

rows.text: 拿開熱接工具之後，還得等什麼，才會接成一件？
rows.locator: once cooled
rows.action: holding a newly joined boot away from the idle tool

rows.text: 原廠說，冷卻後，沿條與外底便形成一件PVC，鞋底就接好了。
rows.locator: once cooled two components form one piece of PVC
rows.action: resting a joined boot on a plain cooling rack

rows.text: 再把鞋側過來，縫線沿著鞋面下緣走，它下方的沿條，已經和新底連在一起。
rows.locator: completed joining topology; 20–28s
rows.action: pointing to the stitched band above a joined outsole

rows.text: 這道接底程序沒有使用黏著劑，原廠把它寫成靠熱接完成的連接。
rows.locator: sole attached without adhesives; scope this operation only
rows.action: holding a finished joint sample beside an untouched plain brush

rows.text: 可是鞋接好了，新底邊緣還得怎麼處理，才輪得到鞋主人重新穿？
rows.action: moving a newly soled boot toward an edge-finishing station

chapters.title: 新鞋底被修整，舊鞋面被擦亮

rows.text: 新外底的邊緣，先被師傅送到另一部機器前，沿著四周修整。
rows.action: guiding a fresh sole edge against a guarded finishing tool

rows.text: 他握著鞋身，讓鞋底沿著旋轉的工具移動，鞋子也跟著手腕換角度。
rows.action: turning a boot by the wrist beside a rotating edge tool

rows.text: 我覺得有意思的，是新底外緣正被修齊，上半部的使用痕跡卻還留著。
rows.locator: before 0–4s and after 24–28s; editorial observation
rows.action: examining a fresh sole below a creased retained upper

rows.text: 你想留下的舊鞋面，表面那些磨痕，又會怎麼處理？
rows.locator: 24–26s; upper cleaning and polishing service
rows.action: looking closely at scuffs on an old upper above a new sole

rows.text: 師傅在工作檯前拿起布，沿著靴筒和鞋面擦拭，手也跟著鞋身移動。
rows.locator: 24–26s; retained upper
rows.action: wiping the boot shaft with a plain soft cloth

rows.text: 布移過鞋身側邊，擦到已經彎折過的地方，原本灰暗的鞋面開始有了光澤。
rows.locator: 24–26s; before/after visible
rows.action: polishing a curved area on a creased boot upper

rows.text: 維修方把清潔、補色和拋光，列成處理鞋面材料的服務，目標是盡可能恢復外觀。
rows.locator: Description cleaning, repainting and polishing, upper material as much as possible
rows.action: holding a cloth beside a plain bottle and worn boot

rows.text: 同樣是留下舊皮，表面的污漬、顏色和光澤，仍可以交給人重新整理。
rows.locator: cleaning repainting polishing; editorial contrast with full outsole replacement
rows.action: examining the surface of a worn upper beside a folded cleaning cloth

rows.text: 要重做這道接合，維修方得備好哪些東西？
rows.locator: printed p63 dedicated machinery and expertise; same machines methods materials
rows.action: studying a guarded joining machine beside a boot

rows.text: 維修方說，修理會盡可能使用原廠部件；其他替代材料，也要經品牌認可。
rows.locator: original components where possible; alternatives authorised
rows.action: examining a plain replacement component at a repair bench

rows.text: 年報說，修這種沿條與熱封的構造，需要專門的機器和技術。
rows.locator: printed p63 repair bespoke machinery and skills
rows.action: placing an inverted boot next to a heavy stitching tool

rows.text: 授權維修方把自己的做法寫成相同的機器、相同的方法、相同的材料，接回原來的構造。
rows.locator: Same machines. Same methods. Same materials.; attributed partner statement, not independent equipment audit
rows.action: arranging a flexible band and fresh sole at an assembly bench

rows.text: 維修方把最後收尾稱為手工完成；你看師傅的手，接著又移到鞋的哪裡？
rows.locator: authorised partner; all repairs hand finished
rows.action: hand-finishing a lace-up boot on a plain worktable

rows.text: 示範裡，人的手接著轉向鞋帶孔，把黑色鞋帶一段一段重新穿回。
rows.action: threading a dark lace through the eyelets of a finished boot

rows.text: 繩子穿過金屬孔，再跨到另一邊，原本敞開的鞋口，重新收回能穿的樣子。
rows.locator: 26–28s; laces rethreaded through visible open upper; no claim why or when unlacing occurred.
rows.action: pulling a lace across two plain metal eyelets

rows.text: 鞋頭和靴筒整理好，師傅把一雙靴子擺回工作檯，旁邊換成了紙箱。
rows.action: setting a restored pair beside an open unmarked shoebox

rows.text: 這雙鞋怎麼離開工作檯，重新回到送修的人手裡？
rows.locator: returned to you; 29–34s
rows.action: lowering a finished pair toward a waiting plain box

rows.text: 師傅把靴子收進紙箱，再把箱蓋折好；拆修的示範，最後停在一個能寄走的包裹。
rows.action: folding the lid of a plain shoebox around a restored pair

rows.text: 而那位在七月留下評論的送修者，也等到了修理完成的通知。
rows.locator: few days after receipt, completion notification
rows.action: looking at a blank completion message beside an empty shoe shelf

rows.text: 對方說，維修方收到鞋後幾天，又傳來消息：鞋已修好，正在回程。
rows.locator: completion and return update
rows.action: reading a blank return notification at a simple table

rows.text: 這位送修者寫，從皇家郵政取走包裹起算，一個星期後，快遞把鞋送了回來。
rows.locator: one week after Royal Mail collection delivered by UPS; individual account
rows.action: receiving a plain parcel at a simple doorway

rows.text: 打開包裹，除了修好的鞋，你還會看見什麼？
rows.locator: personal account new pair of laces; opening preview callback
rows.action: lifting the lid of a plain shoe parcel beside a worn upper

rows.text: 對方在評論裡稱讚接合和外底。
rows.locator: Public review praises welding and sole; no sequence of looking, opening or discovery claimed.
rows.action: opening a box to inspect fresh sole edges

rows.text: 評論還特別提到，維修方多添了一組全新鞋帶。
rows.locator: Review mentions added new pair of laces and appreciation; no observed discovery order.
rows.action: lifting a new pair of plain laces from a shoebox

rows.text: 我喜歡這個細節：主人送走的是一雙用過的鞋，回來後連重新綁鞋帶，都有了新東西。
rows.locator: editorial reaction to stated new laces; not a guarantee
rows.action: holding fresh laces beside a familiar worn boot

rows.text: 對方說，這次對修理和回程速度都很滿意，將來還願意再用這項服務。
rows.locator: personal satisfaction and would use again; no summer-workload speculation
rows.action: placing a restored pair on a shoe shelf

rows.text: 另一位送修者在二〇二五年一月寫下，腳穿回去時，最滿意的是什麼？
rows.locator: review published 2025-01-08
rows.action: writing a blank comment beside a pair of repaired boots

rows.text: 那則評論寫，新底、沿條和縫線看起來很好，像有了一雙新靴，卻不用重新忍受磨合。
rows.locator: personal analogy no agony of breaking in; not measured comfort or general promise
rows.action: sliding a foot into a repaired boot with a creased upper

rows.text: 你會在這種話裡，聽出留下上半部的意思：穿著者想接著用的，是已經跟自己走過路的那一雙。
rows.locator: editorial interpretation of attributed views
rows.action: standing beside a familiar pair with fresh sole edges

rows.text: 現在送修，網站預估要等多久？
rows.locator: expected turnaround up to 3 weeks; current service, not historical review deadline
rows.action: waiting beside a closed parcel and a plain unmarked calendar

rows.text: 目前網站預估最長約三週，這項服務只受理英國客戶。
rows.locator: Current expected turnaround up to 3 weeks; FAQ only UK customers. Not the reviewer's historical duration.
rows.action: placing a shoe parcel on an unmarked postal counter

rows.text: 鞋回來以後，維修方還提醒，先清掉泥土，再按鞋面材料選保養品，定期重新照料。
rows.locator: Remove dirt; choose right care products; reapply regularly
rows.action: wiping dirt from a worn boot with a plain cloth

rows.text: 對那位七月評論者來說，這次想留下的上半部，跟著修好的靴子一起回來了。
rows.locator: Explicit callback to opening retained-upper stake and reported returned pair; no recap of cutting/stitching/joining sequence, no universal outcome guarantee.
rows.action: lifting a familiar boot with a fresh sole and new laces

rows.text: 如果是你，會把一雙穿出折痕的鞋留下來換底，還是重新穿一雙新鞋？留言告訴我。
rows.action: holding a worn upper beside a new plain shoe

rows.text: 訂閱品牌故事，我們繼續看熟悉的日用品，是怎麼被人做出、用過，再留在生活裡。
rows.action: looking toward the viewer beside a finished boot on a bench

brief:
# C07 馬汀靴 R6｜一雙舊靴從選修到回程

狀態：R6作者最小去重稿，HOLD，待另一位獨立來源／書面配鏡審核與兩位全新隔離讀者。R5來源與讀者收據已封入history/r5，綁定先前稿件；本作者不給本輪SOURCE、敘事或owner核准，不寫verify。

## 問題

一雙鞋底快磨穿、鞋面仍好的馬汀靴，換底時到底換走什麼，穿慣的上半部怎樣跟著回來？

## 一句答案

授權換底服務拆換舊外底、沿條與縫線；留下的鞋面接上新沿條與外底，修邊、清理和穿帶後，整雙裝盒交回穿著者。

## 站主觀點

從公開評論裡的選修、配色與寄件，走到另一次授權示範的刀、機針和熱接工具，再接回評論者的完工通知、回程與新增鞋帶。顧客說自己的使用與感受，示範提供另一次可見的工序；兩者不拼成拍到同一雙實鞋的證明。

### 選項 A：選好的舊靴寄出，工序完成後接回回程

開場保持一雙馬汀靴與穿慣鞋面的尺度，留下拆開範圍與回程新增物兩個未揭結果。收件通知之後，示範第一刀同時交代授權頁所列的拆除範圍；後續機針、熱刀、滾輪、修邊、擦拭和重新穿帶，各帶來可見的新狀態。示範裝盒後，才接回七月評論者的完工消息。

## R4 → R5 作者差異

兩位讀者共同指出的one_line與no_recap為本輪範圍。刪除第二章2023管理層舊靴例子兩句，以及第五章2023展示實鞋、音樂節與其總結四句，避免2025送修和另一次工坊示範中途另起舊年人物故事。不是把不同人物與實鞋改寫成同一雙。

c7r20304的三部件清單併入c7r20301第一刀的真動作，原句刪除；文字明分授權頁的服務範圍與示範中可見的刀，沒有把影片不可辨的每個部件冒稱實見。c7r20312的沿條已車好、外底尚未加入總結刪除，保留前後真正縫上沿條與沿機針轉動的動作。拆除範圍的loop端點改到c7r20301，已刪2023問題的loop一併移除。c7r20515既有問題移到c7r20514之前，先問準備什麼，再接原廠或認可部件和專門機器的具體答案，避免問句出現在部分答案後。其餘存留旁白、prompt與運鏡不改。

## 來源界線

後跟內裡限定、泛稱edge-finishing tool／station、評論只歸因稱讚接合與外底和新增鞋帶，三項既有來源修正逐字保留。兩則公共評論仍是not-verified自述；2025年11月倫敦店、各評論者與38.144秒授權示範不當成同鞋、同人或同次服務。工具溫度只述原廠現行接底工序，不由橙紅亮光量溫，也不把無黏著劑擴到所有修理。

本輪未採新增微動作、澳洲另一雙鞋或其他工法；不增工具名稱、黏膠配方、物流教學、年報數字或無來源動作。逐句原件bytes／SHA、短錨點、示範時間段與prompt繼續綁定claims.json，待獨立reviewer判定。

## 字量與時長

官方duration以整份actual narration timeline為口徑，包含coldopen與有聲CTA，只排另加的5秒intro／21秒outro。正文約3500有效native spokenUnits只是規劃目標；R5的2460與本輪精確units記在author-notes.json及native-initialized-lint.json。actual TTS未知，不把紙面算式、native預估或字量缺口當作已量測的時長結果；不以慢播、停頓、重述或副線填字，保留planning長度風險HOLD。

## 製作規格與交接

category story、現行STORY Sulafat聲音、look只cute-mystery、image-01；匿名英文概念prompt，不畫人名、品牌logo或可讀文件。stillmotion、native每景≤12秒、至少70%插圖規劃，一張原生outro卡。繁中燒錄與CC；coldopen後5秒正式片頭、敘事後21秒正式v4片尾與layout d縮圖仍只是recipe。

原生lint只讀既有正常初始化context，記憶體替換候選doc／brief／series，不改immutable字典或canonical。研究、history、reviews、原舊集、快照與來源cache不改。不跑來源自審或原生讀者投票，不生成TTS／SRT／圖片／音訊／成片，不呼叫provider／後台／Git，不spawn。

## R5 → R6 作者差異

配色只留開場中七月評論者自己的選擇自述。刪c7r20316的配色問句、c7r20317的官方黑線／沿條配色回答與c7r20318的保留舊皮再選顏色總結；不把這些官方選項混進顧客自述。對應配色loop與hook一併刪除。

刪c7r20306再講一次外底換下而皮鞋面留下的總結。本章旁白反應接到c7r20305已露出的接合位置與接下來的工具問題：只表達旁白注意哪個真正尚未回答的動作，不添工具名、目的、溫度或新工序。其餘存留文字、章名、順序、prompt、camera、emotion及原件範圍不變。

R5已刪的2023旁支不加回，一月評論的單人one_line意見不擴大追改。三項hardfix、T7服務範圍與另次示範的區別、公共評論not-verified、650度僅接底工序等界線逐字或完整值保留。本輪為作者修訂，待另一位source reviewer及兩位新隔離讀者；不自行核准來源／敘事或寫verify。whole units包含coldopen與有聲CTA，actual TTS仍未知，未為長度加副線、物流教學、年報或其他工法。
